title: CAT 2025 Question Paper (Slot 2, PYQ) - QA - Percentages
subject: QA

questions.q: A certain amount of money was divided among Pinu, Meena, Rinu and Seema. Pinu received $20\%$ of the total amount and Meena received $40\%$ of the remaining amount. If Seema received $20\%$ less than Pinu, the ratio of the amounts received by Pinu and Rinu is
questions.explain:
Let the total amount be $100$ units.
Pinu receives $20\%$ of 100 = 20 units.
Remaining amount = $100 - 20 = 80$ units.
Meena receives $40\%$ of $80$ = 32 units.
Seema receives $20\%$ less than Pinu. So, Seema = $20 - (20\% \text{ of } 20) = 20 - 4 = 16$ units.
Rinu's share = Total - (Pinu + Meena + Seema) = $100 - (20 + 32 + 16) = 100 - 68 = 32$ units.
The ratio of amounts received by Pinu and Rinu is $20 : 32 = 5 : 8$.
